Keep exact expected response type, term, recipient, reject flag and count=1, afterTerm=t, and afterVote=(IF grant /\ m.type="MsgVote" THEN m.from ELSE v). name: ReadyOwnership
proposed_expression_or_predicate: At EVERY accepted Ready (RawNode.Ready return or Node channel handoff): quotaAfter=quotaBefore, returnedMessages=outBefore, returnedReads=readsBefore, outAfter=EmptyBag, readsAfter=<<>>; prevSoftAfter equals returned SoftState when present, otherwise prevSoftBefore. Ready acceptance leaves prevHardState, log stability and applied cursor unchanged. Remove the old raw/nonraw difference. A preview is not acceptance.

witness.state_or_transition: RawNode has out={m1}, readStates=<<r1>>, quota=q and a new SoftState. RawNode.Ready returns those values and leaves out={}, readStates=<<>>, prevSoftSt equal to the returned SoftState, quota=q.
witness.old_property_or_suite: False: the old raw branch requires out and readStates to remain pending.
witness.proposed_property: True; leaving m1/r1 in the core after delivery is now a failure.

reason: RawNode.Ready now accepts ownership immediately and its result must be handled and advanced. Node speculative preparation must remain read-only.
observer_or_model_work: Extend readyChecks with the returned batch and before/after soft/hard/cursor fields. New ProtocolReady must accept for both wrappers. Move RawNode acceptance out of AdvanceCore; keep one outstanding accepted batch and caller persistence/publication obligations.

name: ReadyAccounting
proposed_expression_or_predicate: Keep the ReadyAccounting invariant expression (history.lostReads={} and existing pagination/cursor checks). Repair the Advance observer: detect actual removals from pre-Advance pending readStates to post-Advance pending readStates on EVERY Advance, independent of b.raw and whether b.reads was empty. Retain sequence/multiplicity evidence for exact preservation; pending reads not in the old batch are not lost merely because they have not yet been handed to the caller.

witness.state_or_transition: Ready B delivered r1; while B is outstanding, r2 is produced. Advance(B) preserves pending readStates=<<r2>>, and application.reads contains r1 only.
witness.old_property_or_suite: False under the old observer: b.reads is nonempty and r2 is absent from application.reads, so it records r2 as lost even when preserved.
witness.proposed_property: True. Conversely, B.reads=<<>> followed by r2 production and erroneous clearing at Advance is missed by the old guard but rejected by the repaired observer.

reason: The no-lost-reads and page-boundary requirements are unchanged. This is a pre-existing observer defect exposed by the new legal interleavings, not a weaker read contract.
observer_or_model_work: Compute loss from actual pre/post output evidence, not from membership in the application queue. The separate AdvancePreservesPendingOutput property also checks exact sequence equality and messages.

name: AdvancePreservesPendingOutput
proposed_expression_or_predicate: For each successful Advance of the outstanding accepted batch, outAfter=outBeforeAdvance, readStatesAfter=readStatesBeforeAdvance, and prevSoftAfter=prevSoftBeforeAdvance. prevHardAfter is the batch HardState if nonempty, otherwise unchanged. Acknowledgement may stabilize only batch entries/snapshot and advance only its applied cursor; later pending work must be available to a subsequent Ready.

witness.state_or_transition: Ready B owns message m1. Receive a heartbeat while B is outstanding, producing distinct m2. Advance(B) incorrectly empties the message buffer.
witness.old_property_or_suite: Old AckPreservation checks log/snapshot/applied state, ReadyAccounting checks reads, and ReadyOwnership checks only Ready; none detects this message loss.
witness.proposed_property: False: m2 must survive. New source TestRawNodeConsumeReady specifies this behavior.

reason: A direct gap remains even after fixing ReadyOwnership: a mutant can accept Ready correctly but still clear newer messages at Advance. Old RawNode documentation excluded Step interleavings; the new API/test expressly supports preserving this work.

reason: This is a pre-existing mismatch between observer and unchanged source guard. Full preservation of AutoLeave during restore is already required; do not weaken positive-cursor obligations.

name: AutoLeaveAttemptExactness
proposed_expression_or_predicate: For an eligible normal Advance, compute quotaBlocked from PRE-attempt quota>0 and quota+AutoLeaveWeight>MaxUncommitted. If blocked, history is unchanged and pendingConf becomes pre-attempt Last. Otherwise append exactly one fresh entry at Last+1 in current term with kind=V2, changes=<<>>, transition=Auto, id=0 and canonical serialized payload; preserve the old prefix. Ineligible Advance appends no automatic leave. Apply the existing committed-entry quota reduction after the attempt. Do not require zero payload weight.

witness.state_or_transition: Eligible Advance with sufficient quota appends V2(changes=<<>>,transition=JointExplicit) at Last+1; or appends nothing while a stale decision=DropQuota and pending=Last remain from an earlier call.
witness.old_property_or_suite: AutoLeaveAdvance accepts the first because it checks only kind and empty changes, and can accept the second via stale decision.
witness.proposed_property: False in both cases; the entry must satisfy IsLeave, or a quota refusal must be justified by this attempt.

reason: The old property remains useful but cannot establish a genuine leave or a genuine quota refusal. The canonical empty V2 is nonzero-sized in this revision. Repeated successful automatic exits and eventual exit remain separately flagged.
